messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from last night's latency spike — we surfaced a regression in tokenization/quant path that only shows up under high-concurrency prompt sets. We should turn this into concrete evals and ownerable action items.

alex: Agreed. Narrow list of things I think we need: 1) a focused prompt-set that reproduces the bad path, 2) a stress/load test that mimics 2000 rps bursts, 3) a chaos drill for model fallback behavior.

lia: +1. I'll start the prompt-set. Posting initial examples here:
```
[\"Invoice extract: total amount?\", \"Summarize commit: fix null pointer in cache\", \"Translate to fr: The server returned an unexpected token\"]
```
These are small but hit the tokenizer edgecases.

jonathan: I can wire the stress test into our runners. Plan: a nightly job that runs burst profile at 03:00 UTC for 30m, then measures tail-latency and error-rate. ETA: Wed (3 days).

maria: Ownership map then: lia -> prompt set + unit eval PR (DUE: Fri EOD), alex -> add regression check into CI/evals orchestrator (DUE: next Wed), jonathan -> stress runner + dashboard panels (DUE: Wed). I'll own the follow-up and triage on-call alerts to ensure we don't regress during rollout.

alex: For CI/evals, I'll add a CI gate that fails on quality regressions > 2% and on latency regressions > 20% for that prompt-set. Quick config snippet: 
```
eval_gate: {
  prompt_set: "tokenization_regressions_v1",
  quality_threshold_pct: 98,
  tail_latency_threshold_ms: 200
}
```

lia: Adding a small suite of negative tests too (malformed tokens, long-prefix). Will open PR with samples and README.

incident-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-033 -> "tokenization/quant mismatch under burst". Action items added to tracker: INC-2026-033-A1..A4.

maria: Can we also schedule a chaos drill for fallback policies? We had a case where fallback repeatedly cycled and amplified load. Suggest a 1-hour drill next Tue where we force model A to fallback to thin-quant B and observe autoscaler behavior.

jonathan: I'll own the drill plan + runbook updates. Will add step-by-step and rollback notes to the runbook. ETA: next Tue prep complete.

alex: One more ask: add these prompt-sets to the regression evals, and tag them so Redwood Optimize can recommend quant profiles that avoid the regression. That way it becomes an input to optimizer.

lia: Tracking in GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/issues/412 (will link PRs there).

ops-bot: Reminder: add action items to "postmortem-actions" board and assign owners.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post a short summary to the PM doc and mark the incident as "monitoring" until we see two consecutive clean nightly runs. Please drop blockers here. :thumbsup:
